ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.
meta.title: Application name, copied from PRD meta.title.
meta.updated_at: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last write.
id: Screen ID matching the entry in screen-index, e.g. 'screen-001--login'.
name: Human-readable screen name, e.g. 'Login'.
module_id: Module ID this screen belongs to, matching module-index.
status: Implementation status: 'complete' — all use cases fully implemented and tested (BE + FE) with no deferred items; 'partial' — some use cases or FE files deferred, see deferred_items; 'wip' — implementation started but not yet functional.
files_generated: Complete list of BE implementation files generated for this screen (routes, controllers, services), as relative paths from the project root.
test_files_generated: Complete list of BE unit test files generated for this screen, as relative paths from the project root.
fe_files_generated: Complete list of FE component or template files generated for this screen (React components, Vue SFCs, Jinja2 templates, etc.), as relative paths from the project root.
fe_test_files_generated: Complete list of FE unit test files generated for this screen, as relative paths from the project root.
implementation_notes: Developer notes about implementation decisions — patterns chosen, deviations from tech spec with reason, performance choices, security notes, FE design system notes. Empty array if none.
deferred_items: Use cases or features from the tech spec intentionally not implemented in this pass.
deferred_items[].description: What was not implemented — reference the usecase_id or endpoint if applicable.
deferred_items[].reason: Why it was deferred — e.g. 'Blocked by missing integration client', 'Out of scope for MVP'.
known_issues: Bugs or incomplete behaviours discovered during implementation that are not yet resolved.
known_issues[].description: What the issue is and where it occurs.
known_issues[].severity: Severity: 'critical' — blocks core functionality; 'major' — significant impact but workaround exists; 'minor' — cosmetic or edge case.
test_results: Test execution results per test type, populated by screen-implement-agent after running all tests. Each entry records the outcome of the most recent test run for that type.
test_results.unit.run_at: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last unit test run, e.g. '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z'. Empty string if not yet run.
test_results.unit.passed: Number of unit test cases that passed in the last run.
test_results.unit.failed: Number of unit test cases that failed in the last run.
test_results.unit.coverage: Line coverage percentage achieved in the last run, e.g. 87.5. Compare against test-strategy.unit_test.coverage_threshold.
test_results.integration.run_at: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last integration (API/BDD) test run. Empty string if not yet run.
test_results.integration.passed: Number of integration test scenarios that passed.
test_results.integration.failed: Number of integration test scenarios that failed.
test_results.component.run_at: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last component test run. Empty string if not yet run or no frontend.
test_results.component.passed: Number of component test cases that passed. 0 if no frontend.
test_results.component.failed: Number of component test cases that failed. 0 if no frontend.
test_results.browser.run_at: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last browser test run. Empty string if not yet run or no frontend.
test_results.browser.passed: Number of browser test scenarios that passed. 0 if no frontend.
test_results.browser.failed: Number of browser test scenarios that failed. 0 if no frontend.
